Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.
  • Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.
  • Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.
  • Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.
  • Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.
  • Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.
  • Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.
  • Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.
  • A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.
  • Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows.
  • A technical background, through a degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent hands-on experience, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Domain experience in market intelligence, news, financial research, or another data-heavy industry.
  • Background at a data provider, enrichment vendor, market intelligence platform, or vertical search company, or experience building vertical data products in-house.
  • Experience evaluating and working with external data providers, including judging quality and negotiating what you actually need.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
  • Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.
  • A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a preference. You will be making tradeoff calls alongside senior search engineers, and you need to have built something at that scale yourself.
  • Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.
  • A strong data foundation: you can design an experiment, read eval results critically, and tell a real quality improvement from noise.
  • Product judgment to match the technical depth: you can decide what to build and what to leave, and defend it to both engineers and customers.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how retrieval fits into agentic workflows.

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
Product Lead 
 Location: Ireland / UK - Remote first 
 Type: Full-time, permanent 
 
 About Kota 
 Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued and global.
 Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.
 
 The Role 
 We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it.
 
You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes.
 
That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive.
 
 What You'll Do 
 Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built

 Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets

 Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 Charging turns products (tariffs), energy usage and tax into the correct charges on every bill. This role owns Charging with a strong tax focus: how tax and exemptions are configured, when and where tax is applied (per-transaction versus per-bill-document) and how charge and tax data feeds finance reporting and ERP. You own the problem end to end. Clients should be able to configure their own tax rules, launch confidently in new markets and trust the data that flows into their ERP without carrying compliance risk themselves.

 Cross-Domain Integration & Alignment

 Lead trade-off discussions across Billing, Payments and Debt and communicating decisions clearly

 Accuracy & Operational Success 
 No misbilling incidents attributable to charging or tax

 Higher share of product, charge and tax changes made by clients without developer involvement. For clients it means they can update a tax rate or add a tax exemption themselves, without waiting for Kraken

 Compliance & Coverage 
 Clean audit and regulation outcomes on charge and tax output and correct on-time tax reporting into ERP. For clients that means their finance teams close month-end without manual tax reconciliation - so that when regulation changes Kraken reflects it and clients aren't carrying that risk

 Charging and tax are not the blocker on client upgrades

 Utilities or energy domain experience

 Exposure to ERP or GL integration

jobs.description:
About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) 

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default 
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds 
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
  • Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.
  • A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a

 Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und Reisebereitschaft.
 

 Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Du baust die technische Produktentwicklung von Grund auf auf: Statt bestehende Strukturen nur zu verwalten, definierst du unsere Standards für Leisten, Passform, Komfort, Tooling und Commercialisation selbst.
 Echter Einfluss auf das Produkt: Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen unmittelbar, wie unsere Schuhe sitzen, funktionieren und sich im Alltag anfühlen.

 Du entwickelst eigene Technologien: Gemeinsam mit starken Partnern entwickelst du eigene Komfortlösungen für Fußbett, Materialien und Sohlenkonstruktionen, statt lediglich bestehende Lösungen einzukaufen.

Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Financial Services
jobs.description:
About Mirakl: 

 Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

 For more information: www.mirakl.com .

 Mirakl in Numbers: 

 
 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

 ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

 
 Our Values: 

 Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

 Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

 
 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 
 The Team You'll Join

 You'll be part of our Financial Services product team. 
Together, you'll be driving the vision and execution of Mirakl's Financial Services products — from payments to embedded banking — to deliver outstanding value to marketplace operators and sellers worldwide.

 

 Your Impact

 Day-to -day, you will define with the Financial Services team the short and long-term roadmap for features within your scope:

 
 Identify new features and evolve existing ones to improve our clients' performance

 Build and maintain market and product analyses to identify functional gaps and investments to be made

 Manage, prioritize and optimize the functional backlog for the development team

 Collect customer feedback and anticipate their future needs

 Champion AI-native product practices: use our AI stack (Claude Cowork, Gemini, Dust, n8n) across discovery, spec writing and delivery, and proactively propose process improvements to increase the squad's velocity and quality.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Project Manager (Relocation to Luxembourg)
jobs.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office. 
 
 About us 
 Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . 
 That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
 
 What you'll be doing 
 As our Senior Strategic Project Manager within the Office of the CEO, you will be a primary execution driver behind our most critical cross-functional initiatives. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting executive leadership with operational, regulatory, product, and business teams across our Luxembourg and Milan hubs.
 While you will work side-by-side with internal Legal, Compliance, and Risk experts who own the regulatory subject matter, your core strength is senior strategic leadership and project execution: acting as a key leader within the organization to orchestrate complex initiatives across different verticals, driving high-impact project timelines, and turning corporate obligations into seamless operational workflows.
 Here's what that looks like in practice:
 Solve complex business challenges - Tackling intricate business problems by developing innovative, data-backed solutions with a consistent user-first approach.

 Stakeholder management and strategic partnership - Managing relationships with C-level stakeholders and acting as a thought partner for leadership on specific strategic areas.

 Strategic influence - Influencing major decisions through in-depth analysis and proven insights, integrating diverse perspectives into coherent strategies.

 Champion methodology and best practices - Developing and introducing new methodologies, best practices, or frameworks within the team or company, ensuring a consistent user-first approach.

 Champion Regulatory Requirements in Roadmap Design - Act as the project manager champion for what regulatory and supervisory requirements apply to a given initiative, ensuring they are proactively factored into project roadmaps at the design stage - partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

 Govern & Monitor Multi-Hub Projects - Establish project governance, track milestones across offices, proactively remove cross-departmental bottlenecks, mitigate delivery risks, and provide crisp, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.

 Anchor Luxembourg Operational Synergies - Serve as an authoritative on-the-ground project leader in Luxembourg, ensuring that financial institution governance requirements seamlessly harmonize with Satispay’s group-wide strategy and product velocity.

 
 Who we're looking for 
 This role needs someone who is a problem-solver that loves teamwork, gets things done, and is ready for real ownership across regulated financial environments.
 Experience - Minimum 6–7 years of hands-on experience within a regulated environment -ideally within high-growth Fintech, Scale-ups, EMI/Banking institutions, or Financial Services.

 Regulatory Expertise - Hands-on knowledge and deep familiarity with compliance, legal, and regulatory matters.

 Master Project Operator - Proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end multi-stakeholder initiatives using structured project management frameworks.

 Fintech & EMI Licensing Awareness - Good high-level familiarity with the fintech landscape, EMI/payment institution dynamics, and European financial regulation concepts (PSD2/PSD3, AML/CFT, GDPR) — enough to translate requirements into project delivery without needing to be the legal specialist yourself.

 Cross-Border Leadership - Demonstrated ability to build consensus, establish momentum, and align priorities across distributed international offices and matrixed teams.

 Executive Presence - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to synthesize technical, operational, and regulatory concepts into clear, executive-level narratives and actionable plans.

 Mobility - Based in Luxembourg with a willingness for frequent, hands-on collaboration travel to our Milan headquarters.

 Languages - Fluent in English (written and spoken). Italian is a strong asset.

 Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
 We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
 Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
 In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
 But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
 
 The Opportunity 
 Billions have gone into enterprise AI. Most of it isn't working — organisations still can't turn model capability into measurable business impact. That's not a training problem or a slide-deck problem. It's a hard, unsolved technical challenge: building the systems that translate what AI can do into how work actually gets done inside real organisations, at scale, with proof it's working. That's the problem Multiverse exists to solve, and it's the one this role exists to sell.
 Multiverse is seeking an exceptional Senior Product Marketing Manager to drive growth across both sides of our marketplace: attracting industry-leading enterprise partners and shaping a best-in-class platform experience for our learners.
 About the role: 
 Lead go-to-market strategy for new product, feature, and narrative launches, effectively guiding cross-functional teams toward common goals.

 Craft sales narratives and enable teams by generating launch excitement and providing compelling assets. You will build segment-focused sales playbooks and establish feedback loops between sales and product to enhance offerings.

 Create compelling, structured messaging and positioning statements that highlight product benefits and resonate with your audience. You will also organise internal communications to ensure company-wide alignment.

 Establish success metrics and analyse product performance, reporting to key stakeholders and using data to refine messaging and GTM strategies.

 Own competitive landscape analysis, becoming an expert on market trends to help shape the product roadmap.

 Partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to align teams, deliver effective launches, and maintain trust with high-expectation stakeholders.

 Champion the voice of the customer in product and commercial decisions via research, feedback, and market analysis, collaborating with external research partners when useful.

 About you: 
 5+ years of relevant product marketing experience, including close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Marketing stakeholders.

 Track record of impact and excellence leading product marketing or strategy initiatives at hyper-growth companies.

 Proactive, effective communicator who adapts easily to changing priorities within a diverse, distributed team.

 Positive-sum mentality, balancing high-level strategic reflection with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute.

 Motivated by high-expectation stakeholders, with a proven ability to earn and retain trust through challenges.

 High internal expectations for what is possible, coupled with the ability to bring others along on that journey.

 Confident user of AI to improve the speed and quality of your work, raising the bar for what is possible within the team.

 Adept at building workflows from scratch: turning ambiguous, 0-to-1 briefs into clear plans with defined success metrics, and owning timelines end-to-end.

 
 

 Benefits 
 Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

 Health & Wellness - private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

 Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

 Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

 Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) 

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

  • Predictable performance, even at scale
  • Secure, compliant environments by default 
  • Real-time observability and profiling built in
  • Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds 
  • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values: 

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other. 

Impact of a Product Manager

As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

What to expect

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

  • Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

  • Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

  • Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

  • Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

  • Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner - Data & Analytics (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Yepoda 
 Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations , from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.
 Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe – online and in over 250 stores. As a certified B Corp™ , we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.
  
 We are looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Product Owner to join our growing Data team at Yepoda. In this role, you will partner closely with our Head of Data & Technology to shape how we build and ship data and analytics products across the business — driving alignment with stakeholders, prototyping ideas hands-on, and making sure our data capabilities translate into real commercial outcomes.
  
 Your Tasks 
 Own the company-wide analytics function, i.e., the KPI framework, reporting cadence, BI tooling/glossary, and our decision-support and reporting standards.

 Own the product delivery roadmap for data initiatives for Yepoda's central Data analytics team.

 Translate commercial questions (CAC/LTV, channel mix, contribution margin, cohort behaviour, inventory turnover, etc.) from Marketing, Operations, Finance and other functions into scoped, prioritized data products and repeatable analyses.

 Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that data engineering and analytics teams can execute against without ambiguity. Be the person who closes the gap between "the business wants something" and "the team knows what to build."

 Lead discovery and drive experimentation with stakeholders for new data capabilities, from self-serve analytics tooling to ML-powered features.
  

 Your Profile 
 3-5 years in a product management or product owner role in BI or Analytics or closely adjacent role at a relevant D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brand.

 Strong business understanding, you think in terms of impact, not just output. Deep understanding of D2C metrics (e.g., CAC, LTV, CIR/ROAS, contribution margin, cohort analytics, marketing attribution, etc).

 Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to operate at C-level, translating fuzzy commercial questions into sharp, defensible analyses

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving fast in a startup environment. You create structure rather than waiting for it.

 Excellent written and spoken English.

  
 Nice to Have 
 Exposure to modern data stack concepts (data warehouses, Self-Serve Analytics tools, ML pipelines); you don't need to build them, but knowing the landscape helps.

 Experience writing SQL or working directly with data and AI tools such as Omni and Claude.

  
 What We Offer 
 Dynamic Environment : The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

 Accelerate Your Career : Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

 Inspiring Workspace : Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

 Hybrid Working : We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

 We Value Diversity : We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Subscriptions
jobs.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

 The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

 This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

 What You Will Do 

 Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets.

 Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout.

 Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision.

 Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap.

 Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments.

 Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed.

 Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different.

 Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction.

 Where You'll Be 

 You have a strong track record in product management and have shipped consumer-facing products or features at scale, with experience that translates well to subscription, marketplace, consumer growth, or media environments.

 You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay.

 You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth.

 You're fluent in experimentation and A/B testing and are confident interpreting funnel, cohort, and behavioral analysis to make thoughtful prioritization decisions.

 You know how to navigate the complexity of a global consumer business across different segments, markets, and competitive dynamics, balancing global consistency with local relevance.

 You bring strong judgment about when to optimize, when to invest more deeply, and when to leave something alone, balancing user value, revenue impact, and operational cost.

 You're a clear communicator and collaborative partner across product, design, engineering, marketing, research, data science, and regional teams, and you can align people around shared outcomes.

 You're comfortable working through open-ended problems, learning quickly through experimentation, and adapting your approach based on evidence.

 Where You Will Be 

 This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.

 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

About Tandem Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem. 

 We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures. 

 We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members.  

 Your role will be to: Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests. 

 Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas. 

 Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket. 

 Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on. 

 

 You are the right fit for the role if you: Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale. 

 Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics. 

 Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped. 

 Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English. 

 Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there. 

 Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved. 

 Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations. 

 

 The benefits 
Passion for languages:  
 We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us. 

 Take a deep dive:  
 As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style. 

 Teams who train together, stay together:  
 We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead. 

 It takes a team to Tandem:  
 Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights. 

 Balance matters:  
 Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax. 

 Modern family:  
 As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem. 

 Relocation without the stress:  
 If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen … a ls  Senior Product Manager:in Service Cockpit  entwickelst du einen intern getesteten Prototypen zu einer produktiven Anwendung weiter. Damit können unsere Servicetechniker:innen Wärmepumpen aus der Ferne prüfen, Fehler schneller eingrenzen und sichere Einstellungen vornehmen. 
 Dein Ziel: weniger Vor-Ort-Einsätze und ein Werkzeug, das im Servicealltag wirklich hilft. 

 Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Herstellerwelten und baust das Produkt selbst, mit AI als deinem Entwicklungsteam. Du spezifizierst, gestaltest, baust, bringst es live und betreibst es. Ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam gibt es für diese Rolle nicht, und es wird keines geben. Wer Tickets schreiben und übergeben will, ist hier falsch. 

 Wenn Du daran Spaß hast das Service Cockpit gemeinsam mit unseren Techniker:innen  von der Discovery bis zum Betrieb aufzubauen , den intern getesteten Read-only-Prototypen in kurzen Zyklen zu einer stabilen Produktivanwendung weiterzuentwickeln und die technische Basis selbst festzulegen 
 ein  kanonisches Datenmodell  für unsere eigene Wärmepumpenplattform sowie die Systeme von Buderus und LG zu definieren und mit unserem Datenteam umzusetzen 
 fehlende Messwerte, unklare Fehlercodes, technische Datenlücken und fehlende Zugänge  mit Analytics, HEMS, Platform, IT, Security und den Herstellern zu klären 
 sichere Schreibzugriffe  für ausgewählte Einstellungen zu bauen, Rollen und Berechtigungen abzustimmen und  wiederkehrende Wartungsaufgaben aus der Ferne zu automatisieren 
 am echten Fall mit unseren Techniker:innen zu arbeiten,  vermiedene Anfahrten und die First-Time-Fix-Rate zu messen  und die Plattform danach auszubauen: mit Kundenreporting, Predictive Maintenance gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Science-Team, weiteren Assetklassen, einer nativen App und der Anbindung an unsere Serviceprozesse 
 

 Und Dich hier wiedererkennst Erfahrung & Ownership:  Du bringst  mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung  im digitalen Produktmanagement, in Product Engineering oder mit Datenprodukten mit. Du hast Produkte selbst bis in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht, Verantwortung für ein unfertiges Produkt übernommen, eigene Prioritäten gesetzt und gemessen, ob deine Lösung im Alltag tatsächlich etwas verbessert. 
 Build-Erfahrung:  Du hast  eigenständig funktionierende Anwendungen mit AI-Coding-Tools gebaut . Im Gespräch zeigst du uns, was du entwickelt hast, und erklärst deine technischen Entscheidungen. 
 Datenverständnis:  Du kannst dich in unbekannte  Sensor-, Zeitreihen- und API-Daten  einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge erkennen und benennen, welche Werte oder Zugänge fehlen.  SQL und BI-Tools  gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du musst nicht jedes Datenproblem allein lösen. Du löst es mit  AI, unserem Datenteam und Tech  und weißt, was du dort anfordern musst. 
 Produkturteil:  Du entwickelst professionelle Oberflächen für Menschen, die unter Zeitdruck arbeiten. Deine Entscheidungen leitest du aus den Aufgaben der Techniker:innen ab, nicht aus den Feldern, die ein System zufällig liefert. 
 Schnittstellenarbeit:  Du hast Daten oder Zugänge von Herstellern, Dienstleistern oder internen Plattformteams beschafft und dabei auch bei Widerständen den Überblick behalten. 
 Wärmepumpen:Wärmepumpen-Expertise ist keine Voraussetzung.  Niemand wird gleichzeitig Experte für drei Herstellerwelten. Wir brauchen jemanden, der  in Daten erkennt, was passiert, und die richtigen Fragen stellt . Die fachliche Tiefe baust du in den ersten Monaten auf. Dafür ist Zeit vorgesehen. 
 Sprachen:  Du sprichst  sehr gut Englisch  und mindestens  Deutsch auf B2-Niveau . 
 

 Was wir Dir bieten Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet  ab 80.000€ bis 92.000€* 
 Eine  Unternehmenskultur , die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund. 
 Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit  Dachterrasse , in dem auch  Hunde willkommen  sind. 
 Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie  Lunch & Learn  und  Drinks & Action . 
 Bilde Dich weiter!  Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für  Trainings  und  Fortbildungen  durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches. 
 Beweg Dich mit Deinem  JobRad, klimafreundlich  durch die Stadt. 
 Die Möglichkeit, dein persönliches  Wunsch-Elektroauto  bequem mıt  FINN JobAuto  Leasing. 
 Corporate Benefits:  Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen. 
 Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher investieren wir für dich in deine physische sowie psychische Gesundheit und bieten dir neben  30 Tagen Urlaub  und weiteren zahlreiche Vergünstigungen über die  Corporate Benefits  auch eine vergünstigte  Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft  und Zugang zu  nilo.health , einer Plattform zur mentalen Gesundheitsvorsorge. 
 Sicherheit & Vorsorge:  Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und sorgen für Deine Zukunft: Dein Beitrag zur  bAV  und  BUV  wird durch einen erhöhten Arbeitgeberzuschuss von  20%  unterstützt. 
 

 Über uns Jede Bewerbung

jobs.title: Product Manager Customer Care (f/m/d) | Fixed-Term Parental Leave Cover
jobs.description:
We're looking for Join our innovative team at thermondo as a Product Manger (f/m/d and make a significant impact in reducing carbon footprints in private households. 

We value proactive problem-solving, innovative technology solutions, and the ability to clearly communicate technical information across departments. If you are a passionate to leverage technology for a sustainable future, thermondo is the place for you.

 If you enjoy this Developing and executing a strategic product roadmap for Customer Care, ensuring that customers receive fast, high-quality resolutions.
 Identifying the right opportunities, testing ideas quickly with AI prototypes and turning validated concepts into useful products.
 Leading a cross-functional team through discovery, prioritisation and delivery.
 Standardising and automating operational processes with the Customer Care leadership team, ensuring that new solutions work in day-to-day operations.
 Measuring the impact of your products through customer satisfaction, user feedback and adoption, as well as resolution times and quality, and continuously improving based on what you learn.
 

 And recognise yourself here You have at least three years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally in Customer Care, Service, Support, After-Sales or a related operational environment.
 Customer Care products: You have built or improved products, workflows or digital experiences that help customers find answers or resolve issues.
 CRM systems: You have hands-on experience with CRM systems. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud is particularly relevant.
 AI applications: You have a strong curiosity about AI and initial practical experience with AI copilots, agents or comparable solutions in a product or operational context.
  Automation: You have standardised or automated processes to improve efficiency, quality or consistency.
 Data-driven product work: You use metrics, customer feedback and qualitative insights to prioritise opportunities and measure product impact.
 Stakeholder management : You can align business partners with different perspectives around a clear roadmap and make sound prioritisation decisions.
 Very good German skills at C1 level and English skills at C2 level are required.
 

 What we have to offer In this role, you can expect an attractive compensation package starting from €62.000
 Join a team of Product Managers, Software Engineers, Designers, Data and Salesforce people who are excellent in their craft and are happy to share their knowledge and help you grow alongside them
 Our team is using the latest frameworks and is working with a modern tech stack to build powerful products for our customers, craftspeople, and internal teams
 Boost your skills with a dedicated annual learning budget to spend on conferences, courses or books 
 Choose your own AI coding companion – we provide you with the license for the AI model or assistant of your choice 
 We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world becomes for future generations
 We offer a fantastic culture in the tech team and beyond Modern office in the heart of Berlin
 Work from home - up to 3 days a week
 You receive an Urban Sports Club membership & nilo.health membership
 You can lease a job bike or bring your dog one day/week
 Corporate Benefits at more than 100 partners
 20% employer contribution to your pension and disability insurance
 
 

 About us Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

Software has always been part of thermondo’s DNA. We have been the first to digitize trade a decade ago. Today, our proprietary software enables 800 thermondinos to scale the heating transition in Germany. But we want more. We want to enable fully digitized and smooth customer journey ensuring that all processes are coming together: commercial funnel, procurement, product, supply chain, project management, finance, dispatch, HR planning as well as customer facing offerings for maintenance and home energy management. 
Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments. 
 
Join our product & tech teams and pave the way for climate neutral living.

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”
 
Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. 

 Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
 TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
 DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
 BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
 COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
 USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.
 

 What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
 Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
 Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
 Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
 Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
 Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
 Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
 Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
 Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.
 

 Meet us! 

 10 reasons to choose baramundi! #1 ARRIVE IN PEACE 
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

 #2 FEEL AT HOME 
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

 #3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION 
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

 #4 GET REWARDED 
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

 #5 ENJOY LIFE 
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible work

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Check our open-source projects here.

The Role

We're building something new at Proton and we're hiring a Senior PM to lead it from the front.

This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, community dynamics, and Proton's mission to give people back control over their digital lives. You'll own the roadmap and execution for a product that brings privacy-first community experiences to millions of users. The team is small and senior; the scope is large. You’ll turn an ambitious product direction into clear strategy, crisp requirements, shipped experiences, and measurable outcomes.

We're looking for someone who has lived inside communities products: who understands how engagement compounds, why moderation decisions shape culture, and how trust is built (and destroyed) at scale. If you've helped build or grow a platform where users interact, organize, and belong and you want to do it in a way that doesn't exploit the people using it, this is the role.

What You'll Own

  • Define and drive the product strategy and roadmap end-to-end — from first principles through to shipped features — without waiting for direction from above
  • Own the metrics that matter: activation, engagement, retention, and community health. Set the targets, instrument the product to track them, and course-correct fast when signals shift
  • Translate deep knowledge of how online communities work — growth loops, moderation, network effects, content dynamics — into a clear product point of view and a prioritized execution plan
  • Lead cross-functional execution across a team of 6–12 engineers plus design, data, and growth — maintain velocity, surface blockers early, and keep the team focused on outcomes over activity
  • Drive structured discovery: user research, competitive analysis, and direct feedback loops that keep product decisions grounded in real behaviour, not assumptions
  • Represent the product externally when needed — to users, partners, and internal leadership — with clarity and confidence

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on a social, messaging, or community platform
  • Deep understanding of community product mechanics — you can reason clearly about engagement loops, content moderation trade-offs, trust and safety, and network effects without needing it explained
  • Analytically sharp: you define success in numbers, run structured experiments, and make data-informed calls without losing sight of user intuition
  • Strong, direct communicator — you write and speak with precision, push back when something doesn't make sense, and keep stakeholders aligned without over-meeting
  • Proven ability to lead a product autonomously: you identify the right problem, build the case, and drive it to shipped — without a roadmap handed to you

Nice to Have

  • Experience building privacy-respecting alternatives to mainstream social or community platforms

jobs.title: Sr Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win.
Financial services is a priority growth segment for Chainalysis, including banks, payments companies, fintechs, and other financial institutions. As digital assets become more connected to the financial system, these organizations face new opportunities, regulatory obligations, and financial-crime risks. This role makes the value of Chainalysis clear to the leaders responsible for navigating them.
 
 As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Financial Services, you will own how Chainalysis shows up in the market for these buyers. You will own and shape our intelligence, data, products, AI capabilities, and services into a differentiated customer story—one that connects to real workflows, urgent problems, and business outcomes.

 This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market.
 
 What you’ll be doing 
 Position the value 
 Define and evolve the financial services value narrative: what Chainalysis enables, why it matters, and why we are meaningfully different.

 Build messaging for priority buyer and user personas across compliance, risk, anti-fraud, investigations, and business leadership.

 Create the narratives, proof points, and strategic assets that help sellers communicate differentiated value with conviction.

 Own financial-services competitive intelligence, translating market moves into clear offensive and defensive positioning for deal teams.

 
 Turn value into solutions 
 Partner with Product, R&D, Marketing & Communications, and subject-matter experts to translate innovation into compelling industry solutions, use cases, and sales plays.

 Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.

 Shape customer-facing value narratives for pricing, packaging, and commercial models, including business cases and ROI stories.

 Bring a customer lens to product and market decisions: explain not only what a capability does, but why a Chief Compliance Officer or Head of Financial Crime should care.

 
 Win and learn in market 
 Produce the strategic content that moves financial-services opportunities forward: first-call decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, proof points, and sales plays.

 Partner with GTM Solutions & Readiness to scale the strongest narratives into field tools and enablement.

 Bring customer, field, partner, and competitive insight back into the work — sharpening positioning, converting market evidence into credible stories, and building repeatable use cases.

 
 What you’ll bring:
 
 5–8 years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing, with experience in financial services, fintech, payments, or related regulated industry.

 A demonstrated ability to build positioning and messaging that changes how customers and sellers see a problem—not simply content that fills a library.

 Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.

 Strong understanding of enterprise buying journeys and sales motions in regulated, risk-sensitive environments.

 The ability to connect technical capabilities to business and operational value for both executive buyers and hands-on users.

 A collaborative self-starter, comfortable working across R&D, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders to drive ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward independently.

 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.

 Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

 Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

 Experience marketing to financial institutions at a data, intelligence, security, or enterprise-software company.

 
 You’ll thrive here if: 
You can shape complexity into a story people remember and a sales conversation people can use. You write with precision, bring sound judgment to ambiguous problems, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field.
 AI at Chainalysis 
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - SuperApp
jobs.description:
The Engagement tribe sits at the heart of SumUp's merchant experience, responsible for the product surfaces that 4.3 million business owners interact with every day. As our Senior Product Manager, you'll own the merchant-facing SuperApp end to end, the surface the wider product organisation depends on to build and ship effectively. If you're looking for a role where your product decisions have a direct impact on how millions of businesses run and scale every day, this is it.

 What you'll do:

 
 Own the end-to-end product experience of SumUp's SuperApp, raising the bar on UX quality, information architecture, and navigation across core merchant-facing surfaces

 Identify and execute on activation, upsell, cross-sell, and retention opportunities that drive measurable engagement and long-term value for merchants

 Own the product strategy to make SumUp's SuperApp the most indispensable tools for merchants running a small business globally

 Partner closely with design and data teams, and act as the main point of contact for stakeholders across the business who rely on the SuperApp to reach merchants

 Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams to align priorities and turn merchant insight into a clear roadmap

 
 You'll be great for this role if:

 
 Proven track record as a Senior contributor driving measurable outcomes across engagement, retention, and monetisation

 Deep expertise in product discovery, prioritisation, and outcome-driven delivery, with the ability to work fluently with both quantitative and qualitative data to inform decisions

 Strong visual and UX judgement, with experience leading customer research and giving clear, constructive feedback to design teams

 Comfortable managing stakeholders across design, engineering, and commercial teams to align priorities and drive alignment on roadmap decisions

 
 Why you should join SumUp

 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setu

 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 

 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

 🏙 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

 
 About SumUp

 Be empowered to do more that matters.

Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
