jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.

Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity? 

At Fin, we believe AI agents and human support teams will work symbiotically as one team in one system, increasingly directed by AI, with humans elevated to higher-level roles and engaging directly with customers only in complex, high-stakes moments. So we built Fin to be natively integrated with the Intercom helpdesk, and are completely rethinking what a Helpdesk product should be when Agents do 90%+ resolution. We’re also building exciting new products and capabilities around how human teams collaborate with, are assisted by, and supervised by the AI agent so that they can deliver great customer experiences.

This PMM role will lead PMM for our Intercom helpdesk, loved by over 30k customers, and lead on how to market new capabilities that help human support teams deliver great experiences, with help and guidance from AI Agents. You'll shape how we talk to the 25,000+ businesses already using Intercom, build the narrative for an AI-first helpdesk era, and establish Intercom as the obvious choice for teams who want their AI agent and their human support layer working as one

You'll work directly with product, engineering, sales leadership, and the wider marketing team. This is a builder role for someone who wants to work fast, think from first principles, and help shape the future of PMM at Fin 

What will I be doing? 

  • Shape the ICP and audience for the Intercom helpdesk and additional products for teams - who we're talking to, what their pains are, and what makes them choose us
  • Own core messaging and drive cross-functional alignment on what we're saying, why, and how it shows up everywhere - from the website to the sales deck to the customer email
  • Define and build the external narrative for the AI-first Helpdesk - what it means, why it matters, and why Fin is uniquely positioned to deliver it - and bring it to market in a way that reshapes how buyers think about the category
  • Partner with Product, GTM and Lifecycle on how we communicate product investment and progress to existing customers - turning roadmap momentum into customer confidence that retains and expands accounts
  • Build crisp, high-impact enablement that sales and customer success teams actually use to sell with confidence. Work closely with GTM teams to ensure messaging lands with the customers who need to hear it most
  • Be deeply customer-obsessed - sit with customer support teams, study how they evaluate and adopt, and turn signal into clear insight that shapes what we say
  • Lead launches and go-to-market moments for new products and capapbilties releases, working across the company to deliver impactful launch moments that drive mindshare and pipeline
  • Create high-quality core PMM assets yourself: web pages, first call decks, narratives and scripts launch materials. And maintain the core ‘brain’ of PMM context that feeds our AI-first approach

What we're looking for

This role is for someone who is a hybrid: part strategist, part storyteller, part technologist. You move between customer insight, product detail, competitive analysis, and creative expression without friction.

jobs.description:
Who We Are: 
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.
 Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.
 And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.
 
 🔑 The opportunity
 Omaze is building a new consumer proposition for the UK market to take our prize draws and charitable impact to a whole new level.
 We're looking for a General Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the proposition — from launch through to scale.
 This is a true business-owner role. You'll own the P&L, strategy and performance of the proposition, bringing together Product, Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Operations, Analytics and other teams around a single set of outcomes.
 Your job is to create clarity about what needs to happen, make the right commercial, customer and partner decisions, and ensure the organisation delivers against them with pace and a high bar for quality.
 Initially, you'll take an emerging business model and turn it into something customers love and Omaze can operate successfully at scale. You'll work through the commercial, operational and customer complexities of launching something new, establish its economics and operating model, and build a roadmap for growth.
 As the proposition develops, you'll be accountable for making it better every cycle: improving the customer experience, strengthening the economics, resolving operational friction, identifying growth opportunities and ensuring we learn quickly.
 This is a rare role for someone who combines commercial judgement, product thinking, operational rigour and a strong bias towards action .
 
 🔧 What You’ll Be Doing
 Own the business 
 Own the strategy, P&L and overall performance of the proposition.

 Develop a deep understanding of the economic drivers of the proposition and identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve growth and profitability.

 Set clear goals and KPIs and establish the weekly, monthly and quarterly operating rhythm required to manage the business.

 Partner with finance to build and maintain the financial model, forecasts and operating plan for the business.

 Make clear recommendations about investment, prioritisation and trade-offs.

 Identify emerging risks and opportunities early and ensure the organisation acts on them . 

 Build and evolve the proposition 
 Own the end-to-end customer proposition and ensure we are solving a compelling customer problem.

 Partner with Marketing to develop the go-to-market and customer growth strategy for the proposition.

 Set the direction and priorities for the product roadmap in partnership with Product, Design and Engineering.

 Maintain a high bar for the quality, simplicity and usability of the customer experience.

 Ensure we ship quickly, learn from real customer behaviour and continually improve the proposition.

 Combine customer insight, commercial performance and experimentation to determine what we build next.

 Balance short-term delivery with the longer-term capabilities required to scale.

 Lead across Omaze 
 Act as the single point of accountability for the proposition across the organisation.

 Bring together teams across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Creative, Commercial, Operations, Legal, Finance and Analytics.

 Create clarity around priorities, decisions, ownership and deadlines.

 Resolve cross-functional blockers quickly and escalate where necessary.

 Build trust with senior leaders by providing a clear, data-driven view of performance, risks and opportunities.
 

 🤩 About You
 This isn't a conventional functional leadership position. We're looking for someone who has previously operated as a business owner .

 Significant experience owning and growing a consumer business, product line, category, market or marketplace.

jobs.description:

 Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.
 Overview 
 We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to help redefine what customer understanding looks like in an AI-native world. You'll own a meaningful product surface end-to-end, drive company-level bets, and operate as a senior voice in how Knit thinks about product strategy, AI craft, and customer value.
 You'll ship in two-week cycles alongside one of the strongest engineering benches you'll find at this stage. You'll partner closely with our Director of Product, CTO, CEO, on-staff PhD-level Researchers, and Engineering Leads. This is a force multiplier role in a senior-heavy team, and at this level, we expect your judgment and conviction to shape not just what you ship, but what Knit becomes.

 Success in this role is defined by sharper product decisions, stronger execution, and measurable customer and business impact on the surface you own.

 Product velocity and roadmap reliability: Consistent shipping against outcome-driven commitments, with fewer mid-stream changes and clearer scope on what's in vs. out.

 Customer and business impact: Expansion revenue, win rate, retention, and customer value creation attributable to your product work.

 Build Direct Customer Intuition
 Spend meaningful, consistent time with customers. Work alongside our PhD-level Researchers, but bring your own developed point of view on how users and buyers at Fortune 1000 brands think, what they need, and where the market is moving.

 Make AI-Native Product Decisions
 Own the AI layer of your surface: eval strategies, quality loops, failure-mode design, when to trust the model versus defer to humans. This is what separates us from AI-washed research tools, and you'll help us defend and extend that gap.

 Operate as a Force Multiplier Across R&D and GTM
 Drive clarity on tradeoffs, eliminate mid-stream thrash, and ensure Engineering, Research, and GTM are working from one shared reality about what matters and why. At this level, we expect you to create alignment.

 Contribute to Company-Level Decisions & Roadmap

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - Physical AI/Robotics
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do:

CoreWeave’s Physical AI team is building the essential cloud platform for AI innovators, applying machine learning to solve previously intractable physics and engineering challenges. We operate at the intersection of advanced cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and applied data science, transforming how complex industrial products - such as automotive systems, aircraft, robotics, advanced manufacturing systems, and batteries - are conceived, tested, and developed.

About the role:

As a Staff Product Manager, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of the core components of our Physical AI platform. We're rebuilding the platform from the ground up, so you'll shape the product from day one. You'll drive execution across Research, Data Science, Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering to ship capabilities spanning agentic experiences, applied AI workflows, and enterprise integrations. You will work closely with enterprise customers to understand complex engineering and industrial workflows, identify where emerging AI technologies can create meaningful value, turn field signals into scalable platform improvements, and mentor other product managers across the organisation while setting a high bar for technical depth, product judgement, and customer empathy.

What you’ll do

  • Run discovery in the field, and spend time in front of customers
  • Decide what we build. You’ll take a candidate product from problem to validated concept; use case, customer proof points, and the business case for continuing or stopping
  • Ship products in a small squad, setting roadmap and sequencing work required.
  • Keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned. For the products you own: a one-line pitch, short summary and demo that anyone in the company can follow - what it is, why we’re building it, what’s next. 

Who You Are:

  • Significant experience across product management, product strategy, technical programme leadership, or related roles, with a strong track record of turning complex technologies into products, platforms, or customer outcomes.
  • High versatility with a proven ability to work across multiple technical domains, such as ML modelling, generative AI, agentic workflows, robotics, advanced manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, or data engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.

The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

  • Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.
  • Build and lead the team. Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.
  • Drive design execution across the Enterprise product. Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.
  • Raise the craft bar. Uphold design principles and quality standards on your team. Push designers beyond digitizing workflows toward genuinely rethinking how people work with AI. Hold the line on quality without slowing delivery.
  • Contribute to the design system. Help shape and adopt Scale's shared design system, championing consistent component use and contributing patterns back so a distributed team can build coherently at speed.
  • Ground the team in user needs. Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.
  • Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction. Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

Who you are

  • 3+ years managing product design teams
  • Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into elegant solutions for B2B and beyond
  • Deeply customer-centric, with a track record of grounding design decisions in real user needs and business impact
  • Fluent in how AI is changing design practice and tooling; building AI-native workflows for your team
  • Experience designing for agentic platforms, and excited to shape the future of interaction patterns for AI and human-in-the-loop systems
  • Balance speed and quality; you know how to prioritize ruthlessly and get the team shipping without dropping the craft bar
  • Excellent communicator. You can present to a leaders and a front-line PM and make both feel heard

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Mission bei ucm: Als Technical Product Manager übersetzt du konkrete Probleme von Kunden, flexiblen Mitarbeitenden und internen Teams in Lösungen, die sich im realen Einsatz beweisen und anschließend durch Prozesse, Software oder AI skalieren lassen. Dafür arbeitest du hands-on mit Daten, Prototypen, Automatisierungen und Produktspezifikationen und verbindest Fachbereiche und Engineering vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum produktiven Einsatz. 

 Du sorgst dafür, dass ucm weniger irrelevante Software baut und erfolgreiche Lösungen schneller im gesamten Unternehmen einsetzt. Software und AI sind dabei skalierende Layer für reale Personalarbeit – kein Selbstzweck. 

 Problem-to-Solution Ownership:  Du analysierst operative Probleme, identifizierst die größten Produkthebel und begleitest Lösungen vom Prototyp über die Spezifikation bis zum produktiven Einsatz und zur Erfolgsmessung 

 Hands-on Prototyping & Delivery:  Du testest funktionsfähige Prototypen mit echten Nutzern und übergibst Anforderungen als kleine, technisch belastbare und messbare Produkt-Chunks an Engineering 

 AI- & Tool-Enablement:  Du arbeitest täglich mit LLMs, AI-Workflows und Low-Code-Tools, automatisierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und machst Lösungen auf neue Märkte und akquirierte Unternehmen übertragbar 

 
 Du willst mehr als einen „Job", du willst gestalten, mitwachsen und dich perspektivisch weiterentwickeln. Vielleicht sogar in Richtung Product Lead? Let's talk. 

 Die Zukunft der Arbeitswelt: ucm baut das Rückgrat der studentischen Workforce der Zukunft. Unsere Mission: Better jobs for students. Wir verbinden menschliches Potenzial mit KI-gestützter Effizienz und bringen tausende Talente in Jobs mit echter Wirkung.
 Wir sind eine AI-First-Company. Wir nutzen KI nicht nur, wir bauen unseren gesamten Kern darauf neu auf. Weg von manueller Steuerung. Hin zu Systemen, die eigenständig funktionieren und skalieren.
 Das bedeutet auch: Dinge verändern sich schnell. Prozesse werden neu gedacht. Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen. Du musst bereit sein, dich anzupassen, umzudenken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn nicht alles vorgegeben ist.
 Unser Setup ist klar: Field steht für Umsetzung und Performance vor Ort. Foundry für den Bau von Technologie, Systemen und Wachstum. Frame für Struktur, Steuerung und Skalierbarkeit. Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System. Du baust es mit und bist verantwortlich dafür, dass es funktioniert.

 Deine Aufgaben: Product Discovery & Analyse 

 Analyse der wichtigsten Customer-, Candidate- und Operations-Prozesse inklusive ihrer System- und Datenflüsse 

 Identifikation und Priorisierung der größten Produkthebel mit Baseline, Ziel und klarem Entscheidungspfad 

 Funnel-Analysen und Product Analytics als Grundlage für Entscheidungen 

 
 Prototyping & Umsetzung 

 Entwicklung funktionsfähiger Prototypen und Tests mit echten Nutzern – von Matching und Self-Service über Kampagnensteuerung bis Operations 

 Übersetzung validierter Ideen in Short PRDs, Akzeptanzkriterien und messbare Produkt-Chunks für Engineering 

 Verantwortung für QA und Erfolgsmessung – vom erkannten Problem bis zum validierten Pilot in wenigen Wochen 

 
 Automatisierung & Skalierung 

 Übersetzung wiederkehrender manueller Abläufe in wiederverwendbare Prozesse, Automatisierungen und technische Komponenten 

 Praktischer Einsatz von LLMs, AI-Workflows, Low-Code-Tools und einfachen Skripten 

 Aufbau von Lösungen, die sich auf neue Märkte und akquirierte Unternehmen übertragen lassen, ohne jedes Mal neu gebaut zu werden 

 

 Das bringst du mit: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Technical Product Management, Product Operations, Solution Design oder einer vergleichbaren hands-on Produktrolle 

 Sicherheit in Prozessanalyse, Product Discovery, Prototyping, Short PRDs, Akzeptanzkriterien, QA und Erfolgsmessung 

 Technisches Verständnis von APIs, Datenmodellen, Integrationen, Systemlogik und Architektur-Trade-offs 

 Datenkompetenz in Product Analytics, Funnel-Analysen und grundlegenden SQL-Abfragen 

 Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-Workflows, Low-Code-Tools und einfachen Skripten für Prototypen und Automatisierungen 

 Erfahrung mit CRM- und Automatisierungssystemen wie HubSpot oder vergleichbaren Plattformen 

 Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1/C2) und Englisch (C1) – schriftlich und mündlich

jobs.description:
Gestalte IT-Projekte aktiv und übernimm Verantwortung dort, wo deine Entscheidungen Wirkung zeigen. An der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT treibst du Lösungen voran, die Prozesse verbessern und Unternehmen nachhaltig stärken. Bringe deine Beratungskompetenz, dein Projekt-Know-how und deine Eigeninitiative ein, um Kund*innen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln und Potenziale sichtbar zu machen.

 Was du bei uns machst 

 Du übernimmst die fachliche und organisatorische Leitung anspruchsvoller IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und bringst Kund*innen sicher auf ihrer Cloud Journey voran.

 Du berätst proaktiv in Business Consulting-Fragestellungen und Prozessoptimierungen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT, identifizierst Potenziale und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungsansätze.

 Digitalisierung, Collaboration und Cloud-Shift sind für dich nicht nur Schlagworte, sondern du denkst und handelst entlang moderner IT- und Geschäftsprozesse, um echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.

 Du planst, koordinierst und steuerst Projekte agil, klassisch oder hybrid – dabei kannst du je nach Bedarf auch in der Rolle eines (Technical) Product Owners beim Kunden agieren.

 Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse aktueller IT-Trend-Themen mit, insbesondere zu Cloud-Hyperscalern wie AWS oder Microsoft Azure, und setzt diese gezielt zur Lösung operativer und strategischer Herausforderungen ein.

 Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend auf allen Ebenen – intern im Team wie auch beim Kunden – und präsentierst Ergebnisse, Roadmaps und Empfehlungen professionell und zielführend.

 Hey, wir sind Skaylink.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.description:
Who we are
 Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.
 We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.
 We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.
 In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.
 
 The role 
 Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations.
 You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works.
 You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code.
 What you'll do 
 Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering.

 Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces.

 Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first.

 Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking.

 What we're looking for 
 Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on.

 You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team.

 You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator.

 You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work.

 What sets you apart 
 You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside.

 You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost.

 You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate.

 
 Life at Prior Labs
 You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.
 Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.
 
 Our Commitments
 The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.
 We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II, Consumer (all genders)
jobs.description:
The role

HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision.

As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team, you own what makes that vision real and felt. You're not building the ranking algorithm, you're building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me.

This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make.

What you’ll do

  • Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You'll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform.
  • The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn't just UX work, it's trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack.
  • Cross-Org Data Supplier: You're the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces.
  • AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow. You don't treat AI as a novelty; it's a genuine speed and quality multiplier in your daily practice.
  • Long-Horizon Strategy You manage your domain with real autonomy. You run a flywheel: better profile data → better models → more visible personalization → more signal back to personalization. You own the strategy and sequencing, not just the backlog, thinking 12–18 months out and making the calls that shape the direction of the team.

What you’ll bring

  • Deep personalization or data-collection PM experience. 5+ years of PM experience, with meaningful time on user-facing personalization or data collection products, ideally where the UX is the data pipeline, and where you've shipped for both end customers and downstream data consumers.
  • Strong product taste and customer-facing craft. You have a genuine feel for what makes a consumer experience compelling, trustworthy, and sticky, not just functional. You've built products at scale where millions of people interact with what you ship, and you hold a high bar for the details: the copy, the interaction pattern, the moment of delight. You know the difference between a feature that works and one that earns trust.
  • Data-native. You query your own data (SQL/Python), define your own input/output KPIs, and hold your own in deep-dive technical discussions without needing a data analyst to translate.
  • Cross-org credibility. You've shipped products across organizational boundaries, aligning on shared metrics, maintaining clean contracts with engineering partners, and navigating competing priorities without direct authority.
  • Experimentation with healthy skepticism. You design experiments to validate hypotheses and know how to interpret results without over-indexing on noise. You've made hard calls to kill features based on data.
  • Exceptional communicator. You can make a complex algorithmic concept legible to a non-technical VP and you can write a spec that engineers can actually ship from.
  • The AI edge. You've already incorporated AI-assisted workflows into your daily practice to increase speed, depth of insight, and output quality.

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

As our Senior Product Manager - Outbound Logistics & Returns (m/f/d), you will own and shape the systems behind the journey from order placement to delivery and returns, making them more automated, scalable and efficient.

 Focus on measurable outcomes, using data and relevant metrics to identify problems, set priorities and measure impact
 Validate significant product opportunities through hypothesis-driven discovery and experimentation before committing engineering capacity
 Work closely with Engineering, Logistics & Operations, as well as external 3PL and carrier partners, to build scalable and reliable outbound flows
 Ensure new solutions support our evolving architecture and maintain platform stability and scalability throughout ongoing replatforming
 

 What You Bring 5+ years of product management experience with backend, integration-heavy or operational products
 Hands-on experience with commerce operations systems such as OMS, ERP, WMS, carrier integrations and API-based partner flows
 A proven track record of automating operational processes and delivering measurable improvements
 Strong analytical skills and confidence working with KPIs, dashboards and operational data
 The ability to navigate complex dependencies and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Experience with multi-warehouse fulfillment, international shipping, EDI, or both D2C and B2B/retail order flows is a plus
 Fluent English; German is a plus
 

 What's In It For You Smart Working & Flexibility:  Flexible working hours, hybrid work, and 20 days of workation. We trust you to take ownership: you deliver on our shared goals and structure your day in the way that works best for you. You’ll also start with 28 days of vacation, increasing by one additional day per year of tenure (capped at 30 days), so you always have time to recharge
 Growth & Setup:  A structured onboarding plan to get you started, plus a dedicated development budget for your personal and professional growth. You’ll also receive your own MacBook and a fully equipped office setup with monitors and height-adjustable desks.

On top of that, a fully funded BVG ticket (Jobticket), a subsidy for your fitness membership (Urban Sports Club, Hansefit, or FitX), and a company pension scheme (bAV) via Ginkgo.
 Shared Moments:  Regular team events and company parties to celebrate milestones and successes together.
 

 We're looking for People who share our Mindset For us, it's not just about the what, but above all about the how. You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset: You take initiative and ownership. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked.
 You thrive in change. Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving.
